name: Kinomo
tagline: The Mac motion studio your AI agent drives.
description: Kinomo is a native Mac motion studio driven by AI agents. Direct your videos in plain words and your agent (Claude, Cursor or any MCP client, local or via the remote MCP server at https://kinomo.app/mcp) builds the animation on a real timeline with named chapters and live preview. Aspect ratios 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 3:2; export to H.264, HEVC or ProRes; share review links. Free with 1080p export; paid upgrade adds 4K and HDR export. Requires macOS 15+ on Apple silicon.
